name: René Repasi - Après le § 14 - Am 11
title: REPORT with recommendations to the Commission on the 28th Regime: a new legal framework for innovative companies
part_text: 14 b. Establishes the automatic creation of a European Works Council (EWC) in any S.EU with more than 50 employees in the Union; stresses that the EWC must have effective rights to information, consultation and internal communication; stresses that those provisions should not limit more favourable rights under national law and should be considered as a minimum basis applicable to all S.EUs;
